sample_requests: Train a survival model on a TCGA-READ cohort: TITAN feature extraction + CoxnetSurvivalAnalysis + report c-index + KM curves.
Compare sksurv CoxnetSurvivalAnalysis vs torchsurv CoxMLP on this 80-slide cohort; we want test c-index above 0.7.

smoke_commands.name: lazyslide_survival_imports
smoke_commands.command: ${PYTHON} -c "import lazyslide as zs; import wsidata; assert callable(zs.tl.feature_extraction); assert callable(zs.tl.feature_aggregation); print('imports OK')"

smoke_commands.name: sksurv_torchsurv_imports
smoke_commands.command: ${PYTHON} -c "from sksurv.linear_model import CoxnetSurvivalAnalysis; import torchsurv; print('survival backends OK')"
